By default the adapter only listens. If: By default the adapter only listens. If writing is allowed, a state <room>.Sollwert is created for each room module. It is rounded to the step; most room modules only accept whole degrees (20.5 °C was ignored in a test). A written value is sent as SET 0x01FB to the room module 2 s after the last change, in a quiet gap of the bus cycle (up to 10 tries), and acknowledged (ack) only after the module reports it back. This matches the behaviour of the central control unit.

The adapter listens to the HESP bus (192: The adapter listens to the HESP bus (19200 baud, 8N1). It only sends when enabled under "Control" (room setpoints, heater, clock, periodic parameter polling) or when the button Parameter_lesen is pressed. Data source: an RS485-to-TCP gateway that forwards the bytes transparently (the adapter connects to it, or the gateway connects to the adapter), or an RS485 interface directly on this computer (e.g. a USB-RS485 adapter).
The button \"Parameter_lesen\" (directly: The button "Parameter_lesen" (directly under the instance) queries each module in turn: name (meta 0x0001), directory (meta 0x0033/0x0034/0x0038/0x0039) and then every parameter. The values are stored under <module>.Parameter, the self-description under <module>.Meta. Only read queries are sent, one per bus gap (about every 12 s), so a complete run takes more than an hour. Parameter_lesen_aktiv, _Fortschritt and _Status show the progress.
